# The corpus NCT denominator, and the AACT snapshot it is joined to

**Derived, not quoted.** Every number below is regenerated by a command named beside it.
If a document disagrees with this file, re-run the command — do not reconcile back to a
remembered figure.

```
python scripts/derive_nct_denominator.py
python scripts/derive_nct_denominator.py --payloads <payloads.jsonl>
```

---

## 1. The denominator

Derived at commit **`d5cb7e9d1`** (`origin/main`), 2026-09-01:

| source | distinct NCTs |
|---|---|
| `ssot/*/*.json` | 1,681 |
| `evidence/**/*.json` | 3,966 |
| **UNION — the denominator** | **4,196** |

Files carrying at least one NCT: 234.

### ⛔ The denominator is VERSION-DEPENDENT. Always state the commit.

The same command over the working checkout of `paper-studio/manuscript-review`
(27 files staged/modified) gives:

| source | `origin/main` d5cb7e9d1 | `paper-studio/manuscript-review` |
|---|---|---|
| `ssot` | 1,681 | 2,196 |
| `evidence` | 3,966 | 3,973 |
| **union** | **4,196** | **4,203** |

`ssot` differs by **515 NCTs (31%)** between two trees on one machine at one moment. The
UNION is far more stable (4,196 vs 4,203, 0.17%) because most of those NCTs also occur in
`evidence`. ⇒ **Quote the union, and quote it with a commit.** A bare "our NCT count" is
not a fact about the corpus, it is a fact about one working tree.

This is the same class as an AACT folder name: a label that looks like an identity.

### Retired figures

`2,034` stored NCTs, `412` trial-identity claims and `74` registry payloads were quoted
into this lane from memory. **None regenerates.** No definition tried reproduced 74 —
attempts gave 0, 56, 71 and 362. `402` (object, nct) pairs in `inputs.trials` *does*
reproduce, matching `TRIAL_DRUG_MATCH.rows_checked`. Treat the three as retired.

⚠️ **`re.findall`, never `re.search`.** An earlier count of this corpus returned 1,648
because `re.search` yields only the FIRST match per string, so a prose block naming five
trials contributed one. That is a 548-NCT undercount produced by one wrong function.

---

## 2. Operational definitions

**STORED NCT** — any `/NCT\d{8}/` in `ssot/*/*.json` or `evidence/**/*.json`, via
`re.findall`.

**REGISTRY PAYLOAD** — a record keyed on `nct_id` carrying a non-empty `brief_title` read
from a *registered* AACT snapshot, and carrying `snapshot_data_date`, `read_utc` and
`source_type` **as fields**. Presence of the key is the test; a date written in prose does
not count.

---

## 3. Coverage against the AACT snapshot

Snapshot `2026-08-30` — **data date `2026-08-27`**.

| field | n | of 4,196 |
|---|---|---|
| registry payload (identity) | 4,150 | **98.9%** |
| `arms_registered` (`design_groups.group_type`) | 4,051 | 96.4% |
| `eligibility` (criteria, sex, age bounds) | 4,157 | 98.9% |
| `baseline_population` (enrolled, ALL titles) | 2,076 | 49.4% |
| `results_state = POSTED` | 2,076 | 49.4% |

**The ~49% ceiling is the registry, not our reach.** All results tables cap at 79,889
trials against 599,773 in `eligibilities` — only **13.3% of registered trials post results
at all**.

**"Population" is two different questions with two different coverages:** who was
*eligible* (98.9%) and who was *actually enrolled* (49.4%). Say which one a judgement needs.

---

## 4. ⛔ Standing warnings

**`phase = NA` is not "not a real trial".** `NCT01539226` — a 1,959-participant,
double-blind, placebo-controlled efficacy trial, one of the two trials the flagship
dapivirine review pools — is registered `phase: NA`. **Any phase filter anywhere in this
project silently drops it and reports a clean count.**

**`design_groups.group_type` is the TRIAL'S declared arm role, not this review's role.**
Values: `EXPERIMENTAL`, `PLACEBO_COMPARATOR`, `ACTIVE_COMPARATOR`, `SHAM_COMPARATOR`,
`NO_INTERVENTION`. Map from it; never substitute it for a review-level control assignment.
It is sponsor-declared and unvalidated — the same field family as the `phase: NA` above.

**`result_groups.result_type` is NOT an arm role.** Its values are `Outcome`, `Baseline`,
`Reported Event`, `Participant Flow` — *which results section the row belongs to*. A lane
reaching for "group_type" in `result_groups` gets a plausible-looking answer to a
different question.

**A producer must not pre-filter on a hand-made vocabulary.** An earlier build kept only
whitelisted baseline titles and captured 2,075 of 2,076 trials; the one it lost proved the
point. All baseline titles are now kept and the consumer filters.

---

## 5. NCTs absent from the snapshot — classified, not dropped

46 of our NCTs resolve to nothing in the `2026-08-27` export. One live probe each against
the CT.gov v2 API settles them:

| state | n |
|---|---|
| `MALFORMED_ID_IN_OUR_STORE` (CT.gov 404) | 45 |
| `NOT_IN_SNAPSHOT_BUT_LIVE_ON_CTGOV` | 1 |
| `WITHDRAWN_REGISTRATION` | 0 |

**Probe validated before being believed** — 100% not-found is also the signature of a
broken probe. Positive controls `NCT01539226` and `NCT01617096` return 200 through the
identical endpoint, and the independent batch `filter.ids` path agrees.

`NCT01445665` (COMPLETED, last updated 2018-11-16) is live on CT.gov and **missing from the
AACT export** ⇒ the snapshot is *not* a strict superset of the registry.

The 45 non-existent ids appear across **38 reader-facing HTML pages, 36 apps, 333 ledger
cells**. ⭐ **The corpus already detects and discloses this on the page** — "⚠ UNVERIFIED —
not found in ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, or Europe PMC". This file is an independent fourth
instrument agreeing with that disclosure, plus an exact inventory. What remains open is
that these ids sit in `AUTO_INCLUDE_TRIAL_IDS`: **flagged unverified and still pooled.**
Disclosed and excluded are different things, and only the second changes a number.

## 6. Provenance

Snapshot verified before use: downloaded bytes = advertised `content-length`
(2,515,306,594), MD5 = server etag (`aa7b71410b83992d48ee28e6355dab55`), all 49 archive
members CRC-valid, extracted bytes = central directory, 49/49 tables, zero zero-byte files.

Known-answer control, hand-derived and reproduced exactly on both snapshots:
`NCT01539226` outcome *"The Incidence of Curable STIs"* = **682/1271** and **315/624**.
⚠️ Key that check on `(nct_id, title)`, **never** on the surrogate `id` — AACT re-issues
surrogate ids on every export (`210927292` → `258729064`). See `F:/AACT-storage/
AACT_SNAPSHOT_README.md` and `aact_snapshot_guard.py`, which refuse an unpinned id.
